purpose: Authorize one materially distinct synthetic scorer-capability acceptance path after the sole D-128 attempt failed mandatory cleanup, while preserving its successful field-isolation mechanics as unaccepted evidence and proving cleanup safety before any work begins.
hypothesis: The unchanged eight-field scorer compiler can be accepted on one new two-root official-shaped synthetic attempt when an exact fixed four-component work root is authenticated by the accepted cleanup predicate before root creation and the root plus its parent are absent again before terminal publication.
targeted_failure: A path selected at invocation time or checked only during terminal cleanup can pass all capability mechanics yet leave mutable scorer data behind, creating an invalid acceptance or an outcome-driven retry opportunity.
occam_boundary: Reuse the exact D-129 scoring compiler without modification. Add only one new fixed-root acceptance driver, one aggregate acceptance or rejection terminal, and focused tests. Do not change the scorer fields, source fixture semantics, D-126 capabilities, D-122 metric or diagnostics, chemistry, family boundaries, models, candidates, seeds, fits, predictions, resources, claims, or official authority.
